analysis: Examined the head text of ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift and the ProviderLoop.swift patch and base text. The changes are small and availability-oriented. (1) The preloader's canLoadMore hook is renamed from startupPreloadHasFreeSlot to startupPreloadCanLoadMore at StartupPreload.swift:243 and 312-314. It now also checks startupPreloadStopRequested, so a watchdog can stop the driver before its next candidate. The flag is reset in finishStartupPreload at line 306. The stop is cooperative and never interrupts the current step. The only effect is that fewer models may be preloaded, so the lazy-load path stays as the fallback. This adds no new exposure of prompts, keys or attestation material. It is a minor availability tradeoff (T-029 and T-010 style) and needs no security finding. (2) ProviderLoop.swift adds in-memory state: autopilotAdoptedModelIDs, autopilotHolds, autopilotBusyClock, transitionWatchdog, autopilotStalledCommandId, startupPreloadStopRequested and resliceGateGeneration. It also changes the autopilotHistory tuple to labeled fields with an added detail string. The new types (AutopilotHold, ContinuityClock, TransitionWatchdog) and their consumers (ProviderLoop+AutopilotPlacement, superviseTransitions) are not in the supplied evidence, so the following are unverified: how the detail field is surfaced, for example to the coordinator or the daemon-state file, and whether it can carry sensitive content; how the placement holds are authorized; and how the watchdog cancels operations. Nothing in the supplied diff shows a regression in the encrypted prefix cache (T-041), the attestation/App Attest authorization boundary (TB-011, T-053), or the WebSocket boundary. The startup preload remains gated by the existing ensureModelLoaded path with allowEviction false, and fail-closed self-test retirement is unchanged. A deeper pass should check the unseen autopilot placement and watchdog files, in particular whether autopilotHistory detail strings are transmitted and whether an adopted model keeps serving without re-advertisement checks.
